title: Hide divider above the first section row of an entities card

target.summary: The selector `#states > div:first-child > hui-section-row::part(divider)` matches the first section row even when the card contains a title or header above `#states`. As a result, section rows below a header unconditionally have their divider hidden and will fail to render anything if configured without a label.
notes: faulty selector matches the first section row even when preceded by a card header or title
same faulty selector pattern for the section row label
